description: Representative research questions for evaluating the agent. key_terms is a list of groups; a group is matched when any of its terms appears in the report (case-insensitive). expected_behavior is given to the relevance judge.

questions.question: When was the Python programming language first released, and who created it?
questions.expected_behavior: States the first release year and the creator, citing a reliable source.

questions.question: What does the HTTP 429 status code mean, and which RFC defines it?
questions.expected_behavior: Explains the status code's meaning and names the defining RFC.

questions.question: What is the half-life of carbon-14, and why does it make radiocarbon dating useful?
questions.expected_behavior: Gives the half-life with units and explains its role in dating organic material.

questions.question: Who wrote the paper 'Attention Is All You Need', and when was it published?
questions.expected_behavior: Names the authors (at least the lead author) and the publication year and venue.

questions.question: What is the Server-Sent Events wire format, and how does a browser resume after a disconnect?
questions.expected_behavior: Describes the event/data/id fields and the Last-Event-ID reconnection mechanism.

questions.question: Compare PostgreSQL and SQLite for a small multi-user web application.
questions.expected_behavior: Compares both on concurrency, deployment and operational trade-offs, and gives a conditional recommendation.

questions.question: Compare the free tiers of the Gemini API and the Groq API for building AI agents.
questions.expected_behavior: Compares limits, available models and agent features (e.g. tool calling) for both, noting that limits change.

questions.question: How do React and Vue differ in their approach to state management?
questions.expected_behavior: Contrasts the built-in reactivity models and the common state libraries of each.

questions.question: Compare heat pumps and gas furnaces for heating homes in cold climates.
questions.expected_behavior: Compares efficiency at low temperatures, running and installation costs, and emissions.

questions.question: What are the trade-offs between Server-Sent Events and WebSockets for streaming live progress updates?
questions.expected_behavior: Compares direction of communication, reconnection, proxies/infrastructure and complexity.

questions.question: What are the current free-tier rate limits of the Gemini API?
questions.expected_behavior: Gives current limits from official or recent sources and warns that they change.

questions.question: What is the latest stable release of Python, and what are its headline features?
questions.expected_behavior: Names the latest stable version with its release date and main new features, from python.org or similar.

questions.question: What are the most recent milestones in the implementation timeline of the EU AI Act?
questions.expected_behavior: Lists dated milestones (entry into force, obligations by date) from recent sources.

questions.question: What does OpenAI currently charge per million input tokens for its most capable publicly available API model?
questions.expected_behavior: Gives a current price from the official pricing page and names the model, noting the date checked.

questions.question: What major features were introduced in the most recent major release of React?
questions.expected_behavior: Identifies the latest major version and its key features from react.dev or recent sources.

questions.question: Does intermittent fasting lead to more long-term weight loss than daily calorie restriction?
questions.expected_behavior: Summarises the evidence, notes where studies disagree or are limited, and avoids an overconfident verdict.

questions.question: Is moderate coffee consumption good or bad for heart health?
questions.expected_behavior: Presents findings on both sides, distinguishes observational from trial evidence, and states uncertainty.

questions.question: What will the average price of lithium carbonate be in 2030?
questions.expected_behavior: Makes clear that this is a forecast, reports sourced projections with their ranges, and does not present a single number as fact.

questions.question: Exactly how many monthly active users does the Tavily search API have?
questions.expected_behavior: Says that an exact, verified figure was not found (unless a source states one) rather than inventing a number.

questions.question: Do standing desks improve office workers' productivity?
questions.expected_behavior: Reports mixed or limited evidence honestly and separates productivity from health outcomes.
